title: Expenses of serving warrant.
bodyText: The expenses of serving such warrant shall be adjusted by the court originally issuing the warrant.
bodyHtml: §604-16  [Expenses of serving warrant.]  The expenses of serving such warrant shall be adjusted by the court originally issuing the warrant. [L 1868, p 21; am imp L 1911, c 42; RL 1925, §2283; RL 1935, §3773; RL 1945, §9683; RL 1955, §216-14; HRS §604-16]
